summary.intent: Autonomously run the full post-execute-phase ship loop (verify, secure, crypto/privacy review, security review, validate, simplify, SDK E2E gate, CodeRabbit, ship, resolve PR reviews) for GSD phase 77, a crypto-hygiene/terminology-canonicalization phase touching TEE/IPNS key lifecycle code.
summary.outcome: Reached partway through the pipeline: SECURITY.md written (threats_open:0), VALIDATION.md updated to compliant, two real zeroization gaps fixed (registration.ts try-boundary and verify-filepointer.mts) with a new locking test, CodeRabbit findings triaged (one more fix applied), and a TEE republish e2e failure was root-caused as an environmental scheduling/eligibility issue unrelated to the phase's field rename (proven instead via the tee-worker unit suite). Ship (step 8) and PR review resolution (step 9) had not yet run when the transcript ends.

repo: The sdk-e2e Postgres DB (`cipherbox`) is persistent across local E2E runs, not reset between them — reusing fixture accounts like `alice` can collide on the `ipns_name` unique constraint and cause false failures unrelated to the code under test.

tee-worker containers can be stale relative to source; when a phase renames a TEE wire field, the local tee-worker container must be rebuilt from current source or old/new field-name skew (e.g. encryptedIpnsKey vs encryptedIpnsPrivateKey) will falsely look like a regression.

The republish e2e suite's `processed=0` with zero `/republish` calls to the TEE worker indicates a scheduling/eligibility failure at test setup, not a wire-contract break — distinguishable by checking whether the worker was ever called.

sdk-core's tsconfig excludes `scripts/`; `.mts` scripts are typechecked separately via a root `tsconfig.scripts.json` (confirms prior memory note about a local @types/node flake needing a clean run to trust the result).

The `@cipherbox/crypto` test mock in folder.test.ts omits `hexToBytes`/`bytesToHex`/`wrapIpnsKeyForTee`, so tests exercising the TEE-wrap path must explicitly wire those mocks or they fail for the wrong reason (undefined function, not the intended throw).

code.finding: TEE-wrap block and early validation sat outside the try/finally zeroization block; a malformed TEE pubkey (or early validation throw) leaked 3 minted keys. Fixed by starting the try immediately after key generation, matching the pattern already used in file/index.ts.

userPrivateKey allocated at line 108, but vault GET + loadVaultKeyBlob (lines 116-125) ran before the try at line 134 — a throw there skipped the finally and leaked the private key. Restructured so try opens right after allocation; finally now tolerates an absent vault blob.
Stale provenance comment (referencing an outdated origin) fixed as part of simplify pass since it was in the phase's own new file.

workflow: When a background E2E result looks ambiguous, trace whether the downstream dependency (TEE worker) was actually invoked at all before concluding a code-level regression — grep API logs for the specific call rather than trusting pass/fail counts alone.

Prefer running independent review passes (crypto/privacy, general security, simplify) as parallel background agents while running GSD's own inline gates (secure, validate), then reconcile findings serially.

When a claim is written into a verification artifact (e.g. VALIDATION.md marking TEE round-trip as 'confirmed live') but later evidence shows it wasn't actually proven, go back and correct the artifact rather than leaving an over-claim in place.
Use Monitor/ScheduleWakeup to wait on long-running background jobs (E2E suite, CodeRabbit CLI) instead of polling repeatedly.

friction: TEE e2e republish suite failed twice for environmental reasons (stale tee-worker build, then dirty/persistent DB from prior runs) before a clean run could even be attempted, consuming significant time to distinguish real regression from local-infra noise.

Truncating the DB and re-running still didn't reproduce a clean pass — the republish job processed=0 both times, requiring deep log tracing (job enqueue, worker call count) to conclusively rule out a phase-77 regression.
A background Bash `tail`'s exit code 0 was misread as the E2E run succeeding, when the underlying suite had actually still failed (105/106) — required re-reading full output to catch the discrepancy.
A simplify-scan sub-agent's claim (that client.ts already imported certain codecs) was slightly wrong and had to be independently re-verified via grep before acting on it.
open_items: Ship step (gsd-ship, PR creation, CI polling) and PR review resolution (step 9) not yet executed as of transcript end.

TEE republish e2e (tee-republish.test.ts) local scheduling/eligibility issue (processed=0, job never calls worker) remains unresolved as a local-infra gap — worth a future todo if it recurs, though it was judged orthogonal to phase 77 and not blocking.
CodeRabbit CLI's remaining findings (7 of 8) still need final triage confirmation/disposition beyond the one fixed (#7).
